comment: Really kind, caring professor with a very interesting topic for the class. Regular reading and assignments but nothing too difficult. As long as you follow instructions should get full points for them. Lenient with deadlines which is appreciated. Also offers a TEFL certificate and volunteering in an elementary school alongside which is rewarding.

I absolutely loved my FYS with Dr. Kuti. Readings are interesting but can be dense- don't blow them off, though, because the content builds throughout the semester. Very few assignments and she's very reasonable with grades and deadlines.

Great class! The teacher is the nicest person and so understanding. There is very little work that you have to do outside of class especially compared to other FYS classes. As long as you show up to class and submit the few assignments, you will end with an A.

Dr. Kuti is a good professor and the class was super easy. There were some project presentations, group discussions, a journal, and a final paper. The topic was interesting, but the lectures were not super engaging.

There was a lot of writing, but since journals were only graded every 4 weeks you could get away with putting them off sometimes. She's a good lecturer, and I looked forward to going to class. Though there were a lot of reading assignments, they were pretty informative. The discussion questions in class could often be answered without reading.

She is super sweet and caring about her students. Will reach out if you are struggling and is really passionate about learning and her class. Lots of reading assigned but you can get away with skimming and lots of small assignments but they aren't too difficult. Subject itself can be boring/confusing but still a pretty easy FYS.

You can tell Dr. Kuti is passionate and interested in linguistics, and this makes her class that much more enjoyable. Of course, this course wouldn't be for you if you have no interest in linguistics. Dr. Kuti is kind and positive, and she always put a smile on my face. I recommend taking her class if you have the opportunity!

Class was chill. Pretty much deals with language acquisition for non-english speakers, and also what are the strategies to learn another language so class is super interesting. Not heavy on writing, but you will usually need to answer some prompts for next class (journal). Some days there are discussions about the book that we are reading.

Loved her. Class is pretty easy and she's super nice. Have to do some minor work as expected but nothing is too hard. Don't have to read the books but might wanna know what's going on sometimes. Highly recommend for an FYS. You definitely want an easy one with a chill teacher and she's perfect. Actually learn some cool stuff too.
